footer.tagline: One-on-one language lessons with teachers you choose, on a schedule that works across timezones.

home.heroTitle: Learn a language with a real teacher
home.heroBody: One-on-one video lessons in English, Russian and more, from teachers across Uzbekistan. Pay per lesson in so'm.
home.step1Body: Filter by language, price, and focus. Watch a one-minute intro before you commit to anything.
home.step2Body: Pick a slot from the teacher's calendar. Times show in your timezone — no maths to do.
home.step3Body: You get a video link and a reminder. Pay in so'm after the lesson is confirmed, not before.
home.teachBody: Teachers from across Uzbekistan run their lessons on FindTutor. Set your own rates and hours; we handle scheduling, payments and payouts to your card in so'm.
home.languagesBody: Pick a language to see who teaches it, what they charge, and what their students say.
home.tabBody: {count, plural, one {# teacher} other {# teachers}} offer {language} lessons — from exam prep to everyday conversation. Watch their intro videos, then book a time that suits you.
